title: PM-ENG 1:1 prep - Jasmin Cho
content:
Notes for weekly 1:1 with Eng Lead (Ethan) — focus: API / Console / Dedicated / Private. Quick objectives: unblock Dedicated capacity rollout, align on Console telemetry framing for SLO alerts, confirm KMS plan for Private, surface potential perf regression from recent runtime change and decide mitigation path.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick sync (5m): status, major wins, urgent escalations.
2) Dedicated rollout (8m): capacity commit timeline, burn rate, canary targets, telemetry we need from infra.
3) Console & observability (7m): new SLO dashboards, alerting thresholds, cost/latency heatmaps per-route.
4) Private/KMS & security (5m): customer requirements, integration plan, timelines.
5) Blockers & action items (5m).

Current status highlights (to share):
- Hosted API: adoption steady; paid usage +12% last 30 days. No new incidents.
- Dedicated: 2 pilot customers signed — onboarding scheduled next week. Need to confirm GPU pool sizing and burst policy before onboarding.
- Private: 1 NDA customer evaluating; they've asked for HSM/KMS integration + longer audit retention.
- Console: MVP telemetry shipped; early feedback: ops want per-route p50/p95 token latency split and token-cost breakdown.

Open questions I want to ask Ethan:
- Dedicated capacity sizing: given the pilots' expected qps, do we need to pre-warm additional nodes or can autoscaling handle initial spikes? (what's the cold-start profile?)
- Canary policy: for Dedicated we set 5% traffic canary. Do you feel 5% is safe for these customers or do we need staged canaries with a small internal test first?
- Runtime regression: after PR #412 (kernel selection tweak), e2e tests show a ~6% p95 latency increase for long context (>4k). Have we validated in prod-like infra? If not, want to agree on rollback vs prioritized fix plan.
- Console telemetry: can we add a short-lived sampling tag to requests to trace through runtime switchover during canary? Is there cost/throughput impact?
- Private KMS: what's the blocker for HSM integration—lack of vendor creds, infra automation, or security review?

Potential blockers I should raise:
- Capacity billing alignment: finance needs committed-cost estimates for Dedicated pilots before they approve resource reservations. We need a clear per-GPU and per-hour number + expected utilization assumptions.
- Security review: Private deployment security scoping docs overdue; legal needs them before client demo.
- Telemetry gaps: console currently lacks token-level attribution to model-variant for some internal routes, making regressions hard to attribute.

Proposed decisions I want from the 1:1:
- Approve a temporary rollback of PR #412 to keep p95 stable while engineering investigates, OR set immediate mitigation (quantization fallback) if rollback is risky.
- Confirm Dedicated canary policy: 3-stage (internal smoke -> 5% customer -> 25% customer) OR simpler 5% ramp.
- Commit to KMS integration owner and rough ETA (target: initial KMS flow for Private by end of Q2).

Draft follow-ups / action items (write down here so I can send a short recap after the 1:1):
- [Ethan] Validate cold-start profile for Dedicated pools and recommend pre-warm thresholds (due: 2026-03-09).
- [Ethan + Infra] Provide committed-cost estimate for Dedicated pilot (per-GPU/hr + utilization assumptions) for finance (due: 2026-03-05).
- [Ethan] Decide on PR #412 rollback vs mitigation and open incident/regression ticket with root-cause owners (due: 2026-03-04).
- [Console Eng] Add per-route p50/p95 split and token-cost breakdown widget to the console dashboard (owner: Priya Shah; due: 2026-03-18).
- [Security] Share Private deployment security scoping doc for legal review (owner: Samir Kapoor; due: 2026-03-06).
- [Infra + Security] Confirm KMS/HSM vendor list and gating requirements; set owner for implementation (due: 2026-03-12).

Things I will prepare before the 1:1:
- Short slide with Dedicated pilot profiles (qps, token distribution, seq len) + proposed node counts.
- Repro steps and perf traces for PR #412 regression (link to PR + perf artifacts).
- Finance ask: template for committed-cost calc so infra can fill quickly.

Notes to self / talking points (keep informal):
- Emphasize that pilots are time-sensitive; delaying pre-warm + billing could push customers to wait for full dedicated SLA. Need to surface urgency without sounding pushy.
- For runtime regression, prefer data-first approach: if prod-like repro shows regression -> rollback; if intermittent or non-repro -> triage with perf team.
- On Console UX: prioritize the minimum set of telemetry that gives ops confidence (latency, cost per route, model variant mapping). Anything extra can be v1.1.
- For Private/KMS: customers expect KMS support and audit logs; if we can offer an HSM-backed flow for a pilot, it materially increases chance to close.

Post-1:1 follow-up template (send within 24h):
Subject: Recap + action items — 1:1 Jasmin & Ethan (DATE)
Body: Short bullets: decisions made, owners & due dates, any escalations. Attach pilot slides and perf artifacts. Ask for confirmation on any ambiguous items.

Rough timeline / milestones to keep in mind:
- 2026-03-05: Finance needs Dedicated cost estimate (blocking resource reservation).
- 2026-03-09: Pre-warm decision for initial customers (affects onboarding cadence).
- 2026-03-12: KMS vendor decision & owner.
- 2026-03-18: Console telemetry widget for routes (v1).

Random notes / scratch (for me):
- If we push rollback, check downstream feature flags (beam search changes?) that depended on PR #412.
- Consider a short internal canary where we route internal test harness traffic through new kernel-selection path for 24h and monitor p95 separately.

END.
